fusions.name: Warning Spray
fusions.desc: Releases a reeking cone 3 tiles long, dealing 10 poison damage to everything in it, with a 60% chance per hit to leave it [Weakened] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Parting Gift
fusions.desc: Bats a stinking glob that deals 4 poison damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 25% chance to leave it [Damped] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Nothing Hunts Twice
fusions.desc: Turns afflictions back on whoever inflicts them: each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead, for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Musk Bulwark
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 40%, a shield worth 25% of your maximum health closes over you for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
